audit: Independent step4 caption and communicative-scope check
scope: Read-only saved drafts, source code, tables, receipts and figures; no raw photometry/FITS/headers, new fits, protected access or canonical-product edits

findings.finding: Figure3 opening refers to stated uncertainties, whereas plotted coverage includes the timing likelihood and reconstructed covariance; issued forecast uncertainty is not isolated. Caption also omits sample/model definitions needed to stand alone.
findings.proposed_fix: Open with combined forecast-and-timing intervals, conditional on the reconstructed covariance and supplied likelihoods. Add that both panels use2,185 accepted timings of151planets, M0 is the reconstructed issued forecast, and M2 its tails-only correction. Mark the PIT as post-review; define equal planet weight and circle/square symbols briefly.

findings.finding: Table2 caption describes only equal-planet percentile weighting, although table contains pooled percentiles.
findings.proposed_fix: Percentiles are the smallest error whose cumulative weight reaches the level, without interpolation; pooled summaries give each timing equal weight, while equal-planet summaries split each planet's weight equally among its timings.

findings.finding: The phrase median1.9 times forecast SD averaged over planets blurs a weighted median with an arithmetic average. The saved statistic is an inverse-CDF weighted median.
findings.proposed_fix: The median ratio is1.9 when planets receive equal weight, and2.7 when timings receive equal weight. Retain the68%half-width qualification.

findings.finding: Observers can plan on minute-level accuracy for nearly every tested planet sounds like operational assurance for all tested planets, although only70%intended transits and151/156coreplanets yielded scored timings. Neither full-transit capture nor unaccepted forecast errors was measured.
findings.proposed_fix: Among the timings we could accept, issued ExoClock forecasts usually agreed with TESS to minutes. HR858b is the exception: it transited six hours early, far outside its stated uncertainty.

findings.finding: Figure4a has17b/11c/5d independent timings, not the16acceptedb timings in4b; counts and timing error-bar definitions are absent.
findings.proposed_fix: Add17,11and5independent timings for b,c,d in4a. Define bars as conditional profile timing uncertainties in4a; quoted1sigma errors for released inputs and reported68%timing half-widths for accepted outcomes in4b. The independent checks share photons.

findings.finding: Table3 caption does not define M0/M2 or give marginal-uncertainty units, although full dictionary does.
findings.proposed_fix: Add uncertainties in seconds, M0 reconstructed issued forecast, M2 tails correction, and coverage of accepted measured timings convolved with timing uncertainty. No table data changes.

findings.finding: Several appendix captions rely on surrounding prose for model, score or resampling definitions. TableB2 alone does not define M1/M2/M3; TableE1 lacks model definitions/score divisor; TableF1 does not expand PDCSAP; TableG1 point gains are percentage points.
findings.proposed_fix: Add concise defining phrases where a caption must be read independently; reuse or point to a common table note rather than repeating full methods. Preserve conditional vs joint-refit distinctions already explicit in B1/C1.

findings.finding: Parent identified that marker area is not proportional to accepted count. Plot script sets scatter area to6+4.2*sqrt(count).
findings.proposed_fix: Marker size indicates the number of accepted timings (see size legend). No display rebuild needed.
findings.attribution: Parent finding, script checked by this reviewer.

interpretation: No numerical or display-data defect identified. Principal changes are estimand-safe wording, percentile-weight definition and stand-alone caption completeness. Parent owns prose corrections.
